---
title: "Parquet"
---

{{< include ../_setup.qmd >}}

Files ending in `.parquet` or `.pq` are read with
[nanoparquet](https://nanoparquet.r-lib.org/), no flags needed. Point
`--output` (`-o`) at a `.parquet` file to write one.

## Reading

```{bash}
rush run 'df |> dplyr::filter(dep_delay > 10) |> dplyr::select(carrier, origin, dest, dep_delay)' flights.parquet
```

## Writing

Convert CSV to Parquet and read it back:

```{bash}
rush run --output penguins.parquet 'df' penguins.csv
rush run 'head(df, 3)' penguins.parquet
```

## With SQL

Because DuckDB reads Parquet natively, large-file queries run without loading
everything into memory:

```{bash}
rush sql "SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS flights, ROUND(AVG(arr_delay), 1) AS avg_delay
          FROM flights
          GROUP BY carrier
          ORDER BY avg_delay DESC" flights.parquet
```
